products.name: Korvane Aurora 5
products.description: A 6.7-inch flagship with a bright 120 Hz OLED panel, a 50 MP main camera and a battery that comfortably lasts a heavy day. Aluminium frame, IP68 sealing and 5G on every variant. Ships with up to 512 GB of storage for photos and offline media.

products.name: Korvane Aurora 5 Pro
products.description: The larger, faster Aurora with a 6.9-inch 144 Hz display, a triple-lens camera system and 65 W wired charging. Built for people who edit video and play demanding games on the go. Arriving soon.

products.name: Korvane Aurora 4a
products.description: A well-priced 6.4-inch phone that keeps the essentials right: a smooth 90 Hz screen, a dependable 50 MP camera and all-day battery life. IP67 protection and 5G mean it handles rain, commutes and fast networks without fuss.

products.name: Arcwing Spark 12
products.description: A balanced mid-range phone with a 6.5-inch 90 Hz display, a clean 50 MP camera and a big 5000 mAh battery. The splash-resistant body and 5G radio make it an easy everyday choice.

products.name: Arcwing Spark 12 Lite
products.description: The no-nonsense Spark: a 6.6-inch screen, a 5000 mAh battery that goes two days between charges and a 13 MP camera that covers snapshots and video calls. A smart first phone or dependable backup.

products.name: Ferrow Zip 3
products.description: A genuinely compact flagship: a 6.1-inch 120 Hz OLED screen that fits a pocket, a 48 MP camera with optical stabilisation and IP67 protection. Wireless charging and 5G round out the package.

products.name: Ferrow Titan Rugged 5G
products.description: Built for job sites and long hikes, with a reinforced frame, an IP68 rating and an enormous 8000 mAh battery. The 6.6-inch screen stays readable in direct sun, and a 64 MP camera captures detail when it counts.

products.name: Nordvik Ember 7
products.description: A fast, tidy phone with a 6.3-inch 120 Hz screen, a 50 MP dual camera and a 4800 mAh battery with quick charging. The matte glass back resists fingerprints, and IP68 sealing is standard.

products.name: Arcwing Slate 14
products.description: A 14-inch ultraportable at just 1.19 kg, with a sharp 2.8K display, a quiet Core Ultra 7 processor and up to 18 hours of battery life. The aluminium chassis feels premium and the keyboard is a pleasure for long writing sessions.

products.name: Arcwing Slate 13
products.description: The lightest Slate yet: a 13.3-inch screen, 1.05 kg of weight and 15 hours away from the charger. A Core Ultra 5 chip keeps office work, video calls and browsing effortless.

products.name: Arcwing Atlas 16 Pro
products.description: A 16-inch workstation-class laptop with a Ryzen 9 processor, 32 GB of memory and an RTX 4070 for rendering and machine-learning work. A vapour-chamber cooler keeps clocks high under load. Coming soon.

products.name: Nordvik Forge 15
products.description: A 15.6-inch gaming laptop that stays cool and quiet at 1080p high settings, thanks to a Ryzen 7 processor and an RTX 4060. The 144 Hz display and per-key lighting suit both play and work.

products.name: Nordvik Forge 17
products.description: A desktop replacement with a 17.3-inch 165 Hz screen, a Ryzen 9 processor and an RTX 4070. Dual fans and a full-size keyboard keep marathon sessions comfortable, and an extra M.2 slot makes storage upgrades simple.

products.name: Tessel Chrome 14
products.description: A fast, secure 14-inch ChromeOS laptop for school, travel and everyday browsing. It boots in seconds, updates itself quietly and keeps going for 12 hours on a single charge.

products.name: Tessel Studio 16
products.description: A 16-inch creator laptop with a colour-accurate 4K display, a Ryzen 7 processor and an RTX 4050 for photo, video and 3D work. A full SD card slot and Thunderbolt-class ports keep your workflow moving.

products.name: Tessel Everyday 15
products.description: A roomy 15.6-inch laptop for work, study and streaming, with a Ryzen 5 processor, a numeric keypad and a comfortable full-size keyboard. Battery life reaches 11 hours, and storage can be specified up to 1 TB.

products.name: Tessel Slate 11 Pro
products.description: An 11-inch tablet with a fast 120 Hz display, 8 GB of memory and a pressure-sensitive stylus that attaches magnetically. At 470 g it is easy to hold for reading, sketching and note-taking, and the battery lasts 12 hours.

products.name: Tessel Slate 11 Pro 5G
products.description: Everything in the Slate 11 Pro with a built-in 5G modem, so your notes, email and video calls follow you beyond Wi-Fi. A nano-SIM and eSIM are both supported.

products.name: Korvane Pad 10
products.description: A simple, sturdy 10.4-inch tablet for streaming, reading and video calls. Dual speakers and a bright screen make it a great family device at a friendly price.

products.name: Korvane Pad 12 Plus
products.description: A large 12.4-inch tablet with four speakers, a 90 Hz display and a stylus in the box. Split-screen multitasking and a keyboard cover option turn it into a capable second screen for work.

products.name: Arcwing Canvas 13
products.description: A 13-inch Windows 2-in-1 with a detachable keyboard, a 3:2 touchscreen and 16 GB of memory to handle full desktop apps. A kickstand and pen support make it as comfortable for sketching as for spreadsheets.

products.name: Arcwing Canvas Go 10
products.description: A compact 10.5-inch Windows tablet with built-in 5G for field work, inspections and travel. It runs standard desktop software and supports a stylus for forms and signatures.

products.name: Ferrow Reader 8
products.description: A pocketable 8.3-inch tablet that excels at reading, comics and web browsing. At 320 g with a paper-friendly eye-comfort mode, it is easy to hold one-handed for hours.

products.name: Nordvik Sketch 11
products.description: A tablet tuned for drawing, with a laminated 11-inch screen, 4096 pressure levels and a low-latency stylus included. Palm rejection works as you would expect, and a textured finish feels close to paper.

products.name: Quietline Studio ANC
products.description: Over-ear wireless headphones with adaptive noise cancelling that quiets a train carriage or an open-plan office. Plush memory-foam pads, 40 mm drivers and 40 hours of battery make them a comfortable all-day listen.

products.name: Quietline Studio Lite
products.description: A lighter take on the Studio with the same warm, balanced sound but no noise cancelling, which stretches battery life to 50 hours. Foldable and light at 240 g, they slip easily into a bag.

products.name: Quietline Studio Max
products.description: Our most ambitious over-ear: 50 mm drivers with deep, controlled bass, hybrid noise cancelling and a hinged aluminium frame. Choose fabric or leather ear pads to suit your taste.

products.name: Korvane Pulse On-Ear
products.description: Compact on-ear headphones with a punchy, fun sound signature and 30 hours of playback. Multipoint pairing lets you switch from laptop to phone without touching a menu.

products.name: Ferrow Riff Wireless
products.description: Colourful, lightweight on-ear headphones with a 25-hour battery and a sturdy folding hinge. Easy Bluetooth pairing and a built-in microphone make them a solid first pair for school or the commute.

products.name: Nordvik Concert Pro
products.description: Reference-grade wireless over-ears with 45 mm beryllium-coated drivers and adaptive noise cancelling. A premium leather headband, a hard travel case and a 38-hour battery come standard.

products.name: Orbitra Echo Wireless Headset
products.description: A wireless on-ear gaming headset with a detachable boom microphone, a low-latency 2.4 GHz dongle and a huge 60-hour battery. The cushioned headband stays comfortable through long sessions.

products.name: Quietline Buds Pro
products.description: True wireless earbuds with strong adaptive noise cancelling, a natural transparency mode and eight hours of listening per charge. The pocketable case adds three more charges and supports wireless charging.

products.name: Quietline Buds Air
products.description: Lightweight semi-in-ear earbuds with a balanced sound and a comfortable, secure fit. Seven hours of playback and a slim charging case make them easy to carry all day.

products.name: Korvane Drop 2
products.description: Noise-cancelling earbuds with a dependable IPX5 rating and a snug, secure fit for workouts. Dual microphones keep your voice clear on calls in busy streets.

products.name: Korvane Drop 2 Lite
products.description: A pocket-friendly pair that nails the basics: clear sound, a stable Bluetooth connection and touch controls. Five hours per charge, with a compact case for the rest.

products.name: Ferrow Stride Sport Buds
products.description: Sweat-proof earbuds designed for running, with an IPX7 rating and secure stabiliser fins. Nine hours of battery life and a bass-forward tuning keep you moving.

products.name: Nordvik Resonance ANC
products.description: Premium earbuds with hybrid noise cancelling, a wide soundstage and ten hours of playback on a single charge. The aluminium wireless charging case doubles as a stand.

products.name: Orbitra Latency Zero
products.description: Gaming earbuds with a 2.4 GHz USB-C dongle that keeps lag under 30 ms, plus Bluetooth for your phone. Six hours of play per charge and a three-microphone array for clear voice chat.

products.name: Quietline Cube Portable
products.description: A square Bluetooth speaker with a woven grille and a leather loop for hanging from a bag or hook. It delivers room-filling 20 W sound, lasts 12 hours and shrugs off splashes.

products.name: Quietline Cube Mini
products.description: A tiny cylinder speaker that fills a desk or bedside table with clear sound. It runs for 8 hours and is light enough to clip to a backpack.

products.name: Quietline Hall
products.description: A big portable speaker for the garden, the kitchen or a gathering. Two woofers deliver 40 W of powerful sound for up to 20 hours, and the IPX5 body handles rain.

products.name: Korvane Pebble
products.description: A pebble-sized Bluetooth speaker with a surprisingly full sound for its size. It is easy to pair, easy to carry and comes in three colours.

products.name: Nordvik Kiln
products.description: A premium portable with a dense aluminium grille and a rich, tuned-by-ear sound. 30 W of output, a 16-hour battery and a waterproof IPX7 body make it equally at home on a shelf or a beach.

products.name: Ferrow Bump XL
products.description: A party-ready speaker with 60 W of output, deep bass and an auto-adjusting light bar. Pair two together for true stereo, and run it for up to 24 hours between charges.

products.name: Lumenor Aura Portable
products.description: A pocketable speaker with a soft ambient light ring and a fully waterproof body. It plays for 10 hours, floats in a pool and pairs with a second Aura for stereo.

products.name: Orbitra Pace 2
products.description: A slim fitness band with a bright AMOLED screen, 24-hour heart-rate and sleep tracking and a 14-day battery. Swim-proof to 5 ATM, it syncs workouts to your phone automatically.

products.name: Lumenor Tempo
products.description: A refined round smartwatch with a minimalist dial, sleep and stress tracking, and contactless payments. A 5-day battery and swappable straps let it dress up or work out.

products.name: Lumenor Tempo GPS
products.description: An adventure-ready Tempo with dual-band GPS, 10 ATM water resistance and 7 days of battery. A sapphire-glass 1.4-inch display stays crisp outdoors, and it comes in two case sizes.

products.name: Korvane Cadence Square
products.description: A square-faced smartwatch with a vivid 1.7-inch display, built-in GPS and four days of battery. Track workouts, glance at notifications and pay at the till from your wrist.

products.name: Arcwing Tide 2
products.description: A titanium-cased smartwatch for athletes, with multi-band GPS, a sapphire dial and a 10-day battery. Detailed recovery metrics and offline maps make it a serious training companion.

products.name: Ferrow Trail GPS
products.description: A rugged outdoor watch with three-satellite GPS, a barometric altimeter and a 14-day battery. Its reinforced bezel and 10 ATM rating are made for the trail and the swim lane.

products.name: Lumenor Heritage R2
products.description: A newly built 35 mm rangefinder in the classic style, with a bright coupled viewfinder and a sharp fixed 40 mm f/2.0 lens. A built-in light meter keeps exposures accurate, and the all-metal body is made to last decades.

products.name: Lumenor Heritage R4 Premier
products.description: A hand-finished 35 mm rangefinder with a brass top plate, a fast fixed 50 mm f/1.4 lens and a bright, high-contrast viewfinder. Leather trim and a built-in light meter make it the Heritage for photographers who shoot film every day.

products.name: Tessel Boxcam 120
products.description: A simple box camera that makes 6x6 cm negatives on 120 film, with one shutter speed, a fixed-focus lens and a viewfinder you look down into. It is a charming way to slow down and make pictures with a distinctive soft glow.

products.name: Tessel Field 4x5
products.description: A hand-assembled 4x5 field camera in walnut and brass that folds flat for travel. Full front and rear movements give architectural and landscape photographers control over perspective and focus.

products.name: Nordvik DX-24 DSLR
products.description: A 24 MP digital SLR in a compact, all-black body with the classic film-camera look: a bright optical viewfinder, 5 fps burst shooting and 1080p video. Long battery life and a comfortable grip make it a capable first step into interchangeable lenses.

options.bundle: Kit lens, bag and 64 GB card

products.name: Nordvik FX-1 Film SLR
products.description: A manual 35 mm SLR in the classic mould, with a bright pentaprism viewfinder, a built-in light meter and a rugged all-metal body. Pair it with the optional 50 mm f/1.8 lens and you have everything needed to learn film photography properly.

products.name: Orbitra Nova Wireless Controller
products.description: A premium wireless controller with Hall-effect sticks that never drift, programmable rear paddles and a 1000 Hz polling rate for instant response. The textured grips stay comfortable through long sessions.

products.name: Orbitra Neon Controller
products.description: A vivid purple controller with a bold, lit-up look and modern internals: wired and wireless connectivity, responsive triggers and a solid, balanced shape. A great pick for couch co-op.

products.name: Ferrow Retro Six Pad
products.description: A wired six-button pad in a classic shape, ideal for fighting games and retro emulators. A crisp D-pad and a 2 m cable work with any PC.

products.name: Voltrix Strike Wired Gamepad
products.description: A no-fuss wired gamepad for PC with dual analog sticks, a familiar button layout and plug-and-play setup. Built tough and priced to be a spare for friends.

products.name: Ferrow Axis Elite
products.description: A tournament-grade controller with Hall-effect sticks, four remappable rear paddles and swappable thumbsticks. Wired and wireless modes let you play anywhere, and a carry case is available.

products.name: Orbitra Nova Lite
products.description: The easy way into Orbitra: a lightweight wireless controller with comfortable grips and responsive triggers. Pair it with a PC or console in seconds and play for 30 hours before charging.

products.name: Brimley Slab 10K
products.description: A slim 10,000 mAh power bank with a 30 W USB-C port and a USB-A port, enough to charge a phone two or three times. The anodised aluminium shell resists scratches and fits any jacket pocket.

products.name: Brimley Slab 20K
products.description: A 20,000 mAh power bank with 65 W USB-C Power Delivery, strong enough to top up a laptop. A digital readout shows remaining capacity, and three ports charge several devices together.

products.name: Brimley Slab 40K Station
products.description: Our largest power bank: 40,000 mAh (about 148 Wh) and 140 W output to run a laptop, a phone and a tablet at the same time. At over 100 Wh it needs airline approval to fly, so it suits the desk and the car better than the carry-on. Optionally bundled with a 140 W USB-C cable.

products.name: Voltrix Marble 10K Wireless
products.description: A 10,000 mAh power bank with a wireless charging pad on top, plus a 22.5 W USB-C port for fast wired top-ups. The swirled marble finish is unique to every unit.

products.name: Voltrix Link 10K
products.description: A 10,000 mAh power bank with a 3-in-1 cable built in, so you never hunt for the right connector. Multiple tips cover most phones, and a USB-C output handles fast charging.

products.name: Nordvik Peak 20K
products.description: A fast 20,000 mAh power bank with 100 W USB-C output that recharges itself in under two hours. Its fire-retardant casing and temperature monitoring add a layer of safety.

products.name: Ferrow Pocket 5K Slim
products.description: A credit-card-thin 5,000 mAh power bank that slides into a wallet or back pocket. It provides one full phone charge with a 20 W USB-C port.

products.name: Lumenor Mag 10K Wireless
products.description: A 10,000 mAh magnetic power bank that snaps to the back of a compatible phone and charges at 15 W without a cable. A USB-C port handles wired charging and pass-through.

products.name: Brimley 7-Port Switched USB Hub
products.description: Seven USB 3.0 ports with individual on/off switches, so you can cut power to a device without unplugging it. Each port runs at 5 Gbps, and the 1 m lead reaches behind most monitors.

products.name: Voltrix 7-Port Powered Hub
products.description: A powered 7-port USB 3.0 hub that keeps external drives and webcams happy, with a dedicated wall adapter for stable power. Ideal for desks that always run short of ports.

products.name: Brimley USB-A to USB-B Device Cable
products.description: The cable that connects printers, scanners, audio interfaces and keyboards. USB 2.0 speed, shielded for reliable data, with a strain-relieved plug at each end.

products.name: Brimley USB-A to USB-C Charge Cable
products.description: A sturdy USB-A to USB-C cable for charging and syncing phones, tablets and earbuds. A flexible jacket resists tangles and kinks.

products.name: Voltrix USB Cable Kit
products.description: A drawer-rescuing kit of USB-A cables with the connectors that are still lurking in older gear, including Micro-USB, Mini-USB and USB-C. Every cable is the same short, tidy length.

products.name: Voltrix Braided USB-A to USB-C Cable
products.description: A durable USB-A to USB-C cable wrapped in woven nylon, rated for thousands of bends. USB 3.2 Gen 1 delivers fast transfers at 5 Gbps and quick charging.
